meta.name: data-validate
meta.description: Valida uma análise antes de compartilhar — metodologia, precisão e verificações de viés. Use quando revisar uma análise antes de uma apresentação para stakeholders, verificar cálculos e lógica de agregação, conferir se os resultados de uma query SQL parecem corretos, ou avaliar se as conclusões são de fato suportadas pelos dados. Sempre rodar esta skill antes de compartilhar análises baseadas em Stripe, Omie, Licensing ou Evo CRM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证数据分析的准确性、方法论与偏差
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要向利益相关者展示数据分析结果
copy.tagline_en: Validate data analysis for methodology, accuracy, and bias
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often present data analysis to stakeholders

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在你分享分析前自动审查其方法、准确性和偏差，执行 QA 清单，检查常见数据陷阱，提供改进建议，并给出三个信任评级（准备分享、带备注分享、需修订）。
howto.when: 当你要求验证一份分析报告、检查计算结果或评估结论是否被数据支持时触发。通常用于分享给利益相关方之前。

say.text: 帮我验证这份分析报告
say.note: Claude 将全面审查方法、计算和结论。

say.text: 检查这个SQL查询结果是否准确
say.note: Claude 会执行计算抽查和合理性检查。

say.text: 评估这个分析的偏差和局限性
say.note: Claude 会识别常见陷阱并提出改进建议。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude automatically reviews the analysis for methodology, accuracy, and bias before you share it. It runs a QA checklist, checks common data pitfalls, provides improvement suggestions, and generates a trust rating (ready to share, share with caveats, needs revision).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to validate an analysis, verify calculations, or evaluate if conclusions are supported by data. Typically used before sharing with stakeholders.

say_en.text: Validate this analysis report for me.
say_en.note: Claude will perform a comprehensive review.

say_en.text: Check if this SQL query result is accurate.
say_en.note: Claude will do spot-checks and sanity checks.

say_en.text: Assess biases and limitations in this analysis.
say_en.note: Claude will identify common pitfalls and suggest improvements.
